verdict.rationale: Pandoc documents an HTTP server mode (pandoc-server) and a Haskell library, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no evidence shows any downloadable spec for the server or library.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
